title: Unplug mid-operation (procedure)
manual: Connect, and start a push or flash on the card.
While the operation runs, PHYSICALLY UNPLUG the board.
Watch what the card does; plug it back in when it settles.

emulated.note: The unplug is the CABLE, and the cable is `bus.detach(id)` — not a chip reset and not a socket closing. That distinction is a ruling, not a shortcut: on native USB the serial block survives every reset the channel can ask for, so only the cable mints and un-mints a port (M5, virtual_serial.js's header). `detach` errors the open `readable` exactly as Chrome does on a real unplug, which is the half of a replug the sweep is written against.
